comment_en: Command Library — the maintained catalog behind the Guided Command Palette (§6B / roadmap §5). READ-ONLY commands are live in the clean build; CRITICAL/FUTURE commands are preview-wired but execution-gated. Backing values are CONTRACTS the palette dispatches by name (no arbitrary execution). Bilingual per L0.
comment_hy: Command Library — Guided Command Palette-ի հետևի պահվող catalog (§6B / roadmap §5)։ READ-ONLY-ները live են մաքուր build-ում; CRITICAL/FUTURE-ները preview-wired են բայց execution-gated։ backing-ը contract է, palette-ը dispatch է անում ըստ անվան (ոչ arbitrary execution)։ Երկլեզու՝ L0։
availability_legend: CLEAN-BUILD = live now | PHASE-N = live after that phase | RUNTIME = finished-SuperBro cmd | FUTURE = designed, execution deferred to Rollout

commands.name: HELP
commands.purpose_en: List commands and what is safe to run now.
commands.purpose_hy: Թվարկել command-ները ու ինչն է հիմա ապահով.
commands.preview_en: Prints the command catalog; reads nothing on disk except this library.
commands.preview_hy: Տպում է catalog-ը; ոչինչ չի կարդում disk-ից բացի այս library-ից.

commands.name: SHOW REGISTRY
commands.purpose_en: Show registered projects (none yet in the clean build).
commands.purpose_hy: Ցույց տալ registered project-ները (մաքուր build-ում դեռ ոչ մեկը).
commands.preview_en: Reads and prints registry.json (metadata only). Writes nothing.
commands.preview_hy: Կարդում ու տպում է registry.json (միայն metadata)։ Ոչինչ չի գրում.

commands.name: SHOW HEALTH
commands.preview_en: Reads and prints the generated health-dashboard snapshot. Writes nothing.
commands.preview_hy: Կարդում ու տպում է health-dashboard snapshot-ը։ Ոչինչ չի գրում.

commands.name: RUN DOCTOR
commands.files_affected: reads bro.manifest.json, bro.home.json, memory/_own/*, spine/* ; writes none
commands.preview_en: Runs bro-doctor (read-only). Returns GREEN/YELLOW/RED/CRITICAL + exit code. Changes nothing.
commands.preview_hy: Վազեցնում է bro-doctor (read-only)։ Վերադարձնում է GREEN/YELLOW/RED/CRITICAL + exit code։ Ոչինչ չի փոխում.

commands.name: RUN AUDIT
commands.purpose_en: Read-only audit: drift + manifest + hash + boundary; flags only.
commands.purpose_hy: Read-only audit՝ drift + manifest + hash + boundary; միայն flag.
commands.files_affected: reads only; writes none (audit never fixes/moves/deletes)
commands.preview_en: Backing audit suite lands in Phase 2. Until then this command previews only and runs nothing.
commands.preview_hy: Audit suite-ը գալիս է Phase 2-ում։ Մինչ այդ՝ միայն preview, ոչինչ չի վազում.

commands.name: REVIEW QUARANTINE
commands.purpose_en: List quarantine candidates (flags only; no file moved).
commands.purpose_hy: Թվարկել quarantine candidate-ները (միայն flag; ոչ ֆայլ շարժած).
commands.preview_en: Quarantine review lands in Phase 2 (audit suite). Flags candidates only; the move itself is a separate Gev-gated action.
commands.preview_hy: Quarantine review-ը Phase 2-ում է։ Միայն flag; շարժը առանձին Gev-gated action է.

commands.name: RELEASE SPINE
commands.purpose_en: Publish an approved spine release (versioned, pull-based).
commands.preview_en: Release system lands in Phase 4. OD-5: the v1.0.0 cut is deferred. Requires Gev authority + YES. Runs nothing now.
commands.preview_hy: Release system-ը Phase 4-ում է։ OD-5՝ v1.0.0 cut-ը հետաձգված է։ Պահանջում է Gev authority + YES։ Հիմա ոչինչ չի վազում.

commands.name: START BUILD
commands.purpose_en: Begin an approved build phase (finished-SuperBro runtime command).
commands.purpose_hy: Սկսել approved build phase (finished-SuperBro runtime command).
commands.files_affected: depends on the approved phase plan
commands.preview_en: Runtime command. A build phase begins ONLY on Gev's explicit command. Never from a vague input. Runs nothing now.
commands.preview_hy: Runtime command։ Build phase սկսվում է ՄԻԱՅՆ Գևի բացահայտ հրամանով։ Երբեք vague input-ից։ Հիմա ոչինչ չի վազում.

commands.name: REGISTER PROJECT
commands.purpose_en: Register a project in the registry (metadata only, no project files).
commands.purpose_hy: Register անել project registry-ում (միայն metadata, ոչ project ֆայլ).
commands.files_affected: writes memory/_own/registry.json (metadata only); touches NO project content
commands.preview_en: Registry rollout lands in Phase 3 as DRY-RUN only (executes nothing). Refuses a path inside another project's memory.
commands.preview_hy: Registry rollout-ը Phase 3-ում է՝ միայն DRY-RUN (ոչինչ չի կատարում)։ Մերժում է ուրիշ project-ի memory-ի մեջ ընկած path.

commands.name: INSTALL PROJECT BRO
commands.purpose_en: Install X/bro into a project from the template + pull a spine release.
commands.purpose_hy: Install անել X/bro project-ի մեջ template-ից + pull spine release.
commands.files_affected: would create X/bro/ (FUTURE — dry only); touches NO project content in the clean build
commands.preview_en: Install rollout lands in Phase 3 as DRY-RUN only (executes nothing, creates no Project Bro).
commands.preview_hy: Install rollout-ը Phase 3-ում է՝ միայն DRY-RUN (ոչինչ չի կատարում, ոչ Project Bro).

commands.name: UPDATE PROJECT BRO SPINE
commands.purpose_en: Pull an approved release into X/bro, verify hashes, stamp spine_version.
commands.purpose_hy: Pull approved release X/bro-ի մեջ, hash verify, spine_version stamp.
commands.files_affected: would write X/bro/spine/ + manifest (FUTURE — dry only)
commands.preview_en: Spine update rollout lands in Phase 3 as DRY-RUN only; the pull/verify/stamp procedure itself lands in Phase 4.
commands.preview_hy: Spine update-ը Phase 3-ում է՝ միայն DRY-RUN; pull/verify/stamp procedure-ը Phase 4-ում.

commands.name: RUN PROJECT AUDIT
commands.files_affected: reads one project's mirror; writes none
commands.preview_en: Project audit needs an installed Project Bro (Rollout). No project exists in the clean build. Runs nothing now.
commands.preview_hy: Project audit-ը պահանջում է installed Project Bro (Rollout)։ Մաքուր build-ում project չկա։ Հիմա ոչինչ չի վազում.

commands.name: PROMOTE SKILL
commands.purpose_en: Promote a project lesson to the spine (Promotion Gate).
commands.purpose_hy: Promote անել project lesson spine (Promotion Gate).
commands.files_affected: writes a candidate spine rule via the Promotion Gate (Gev-gated)
commands.preview_en: Promotion Gate lands in Phase 4. No project-specific fact enters the spine without it + Gev approval. Runs nothing now.
commands.preview_hy: Promotion Gate-ը Phase 4-ում է։ Ոչ մի project-fact spine չի մտնում առանց դրա + Գևի։ Հիմա ոչինչ չի վազում.

commands.name: CROSS-PROJECT AUDIT
commands.purpose_en: Gev-opened, read-only, scoped cross-project review (default OFF).
commands.purpose_hy: Գևի բացած, read-only, scoped cross-project review (default OFF).
commands.files_affected: reads ≥2 project mirrors; output to one project or Super Bro own-log; exit log required
commands.preview_en: Cross-project mode is default OFF and opens ONLY by explicit Gev command. No projects exist yet. Runs nothing now.
commands.preview_hy: Cross-project mode-ը default OFF է ու բացվում է ՄԻԱՅՆ Գևի բացահայտ հրամանով։ Դեռ project չկա։ Հիմա ոչինչ չի վազում.

commands.name: EXIT
commands.preview_en: Exits the palette loop. Changes nothing.
commands.preview_hy: Դուրս է գալիս palette-ից։ Ոչինչ չի փոխում.
